Topic 4.1: Sewing skills: Knitting ● (Purl and Knit).
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sewing skills: Knitting ● (Purl and Knit)., part of PRODUCTION TECHNIQUES Strand Sub strand Specific learning outcomes Suggested lea in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: how to knit 1. How do you knit an article for household use? 2.Why do we knit household articles?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sewing skills: Knitting ● (Purl and Knit). together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: The learner develops signing and observing skills as they fingerspell and sign terms related to sewing

skills in production techniques.

• Digital literacy: The learner develops the skill of connecting with technology as they use digital devices to watch captioned videos on

how to knit stitches.

• Creativity and imagination: The learner develops experimenting skills as learners knit a household article using basic knitting stitches.

Values:
• Love: As a learner shows compassion to others while participating in group activities.

• Integrity: as the learner prudently uses of materials and equipment in the knitting of household article.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Safety and security: The learners observe safety for self and others as they use sharp tools for knitting.

39

Link to other learning areas:

The Learner relates knitting to weaving technique learnt in creative arts and sports.

Suggested Learning Resources:

• Digital Devices.

• Print reference resources.

• Knitting needles and yarns.

• Real knitting machines. (circular, warp, flat, computerised)
